##### FAQs

What are the highest grossing Bollywood movies of all time?
The highest grossing Bollywood movies include Dangal (₹2,059 crore worldwide), Jawan (₹1,163 crore), Pathaan (₹1,070 crore), Bajrangi Bhaijaan (₹915 crore), Animal (₹911 crore), and Secret Superstar (₹903 crore). These films have set new milestones in global box office collections for Hindi cinema.

Which Bollywood movie holds the highest worldwide box office record?

Dangal holds the highest worldwide box office record for a Bollywood movie, earning around ₹2,059 crore globally. Its unprecedented success was greatly boosted by its massive popularity in China and other international markets.

How much did Dangal collect worldwide?

Dangal collected approximately ₹2,059 crore worldwide, making it the highest grossing Bollywood film ever. This figure includes both the domestic (India) and international box office earnings.

When was Jawan released and how much did it earn?

Jawan was released in 2023.
It earned a worldwide gross of approximately ₹1,163 crore, with ₹640 crore coming from the Indian domestic market. The film was a major commercial success and one of the highest grossers of recent years.

Which Bollywood films crossed ₹500 crore in India?

Several Bollywood films have crossed the ₹500 crore mark in India, including Jawan (₹640 crore), Pathaan (₹543 crore), Animal (₹554 crore), Gadar 2 (₹525 crore), Bajrangi Bhaijaan (₹320 crore, notable but below ₹500 crore), and Sultan (₹300 crore, below ₹500 crore but among top earners).

What makes these Bollywood movies so successful globally?

Their global success is driven by star power, compelling storytelling, high production values, strong music, and extensive overseas distribution. Bollywood’s expanding reach in countries like China, UAE, and the US boosts box office collections. Additionally, stories with universal themes and cultural resonance appeal to diverse audiences worldwide.

### What is Indian cinema’s annual revenue?

Indian cinema generates an annual revenue of more than 10,000 crore rupees (more than $1 billion), collected by films made in several regional languages.

### What is the highest-grossing Indian film?

As of 2025 _Dangal_ (2016; “Wrestling Competition”), starring [Aamir Khan](https://www.britannica.com/biography/Aamir-Khan) , is the biggest Indian blockbuster worldwide, earning 2,070 crore rupees (about $305 million).
